text.p: MobileMedia Corp said on Monday that its expected third quarter earnings would place it in violation of certain loan covenants and that it had begun talks with agent banks on the matter.

The paging and personal communications services provider also said that, given its cash requirements, it was reviewing whether it would be able to make interest payments on its publicly-traded bonds, due in November.

MobileMedia said it was also continuing to work with the Federal Communications Commission to resolve a previously announced filing misrepresentations regarding several hundred of its local transmission operating stations.
The company said it could not predict the outcome of the talks but, as it already said, the outcome could have a material adverse effect on MultiMedia's financial condition and operations.
